system.description:
1st Level Clan Feature

You are capable of manipulating water and wind release chakra, and fusing them together to create mirror like glass constructs that reflect you, and only you within them. As a Bonus action, you can select an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you that is along the ground. Within this space, you conjure a mirror pane that is 6 feet tall, 3 feet wide, and 2 inches thick. This mirror projects only your reflection and is known as your Ice Mirrors.

An Ice Mirror has 10 Hit Points, 20 AC, Resistance to Piercing, Slashing, Cold and Wind Damage, and vulnerable to fire damage and lasts for up to 1 minute. You can maintain up to 2 Ice Mirrors at once, creating an additional Ice Mirrors beyond the limit melts the oldest one. The number of Ice Mirrors you can maintain increases by +1 at 7th, 11th and 15th levels.

While you have at least one Ice Mirrors active, you gain the following abilities;

Join Reflection. By spending 5 feet of movement, while adjacent to an Ice Mirror, you can infuse yourself into it. While infused in this way, you occupy the same space as the glass and your reflection is shown on all active Ice Mirrors. While occupying an Ice Mirror, you can spend 5 feet of movement to exit the Ice Mirror you are occupying, moving into a space that can hold you within 5 feet. If the mirrors HP is reduced to 0 while you are occupying it, remaining damage is applied to you and you exit the destroyed mirror, occupying the space it previously occupied.

Attacking Reflections. When you infuse into a Ice Mirror, while at least one other Ice Mirrors is active, you can make a Stealth check with a rank of Mastery. On a success, gain the benefits of a successful Hide action as creatures cannot tell which mirror you are currently occupying until a creature succeeds a Search.

Mirrors Protection. If you are occupying a glass, all attacks targeting you, instead target the Ice Mirrors. While infused into a glass, you have immunity to the Grappled, Restrained and Prone conditions and cannot be moved against your will, except by teleportation.

Reflective Movement. By spending 10 feet of movement, while occupying a Ice Mirrors, you can teleport into another Ice Mirrors within 30 feet of the current Ice Mirrors you are occupying.

Mirrored Strike. While occupying a Ice Mirrors, when you make a ranged attack, this does not end your successful stealth benefit, if any.
